description: List original data sources used, staged, or reviewed for Homecastr panels. Returns official outbound source URLs, source tier, source status, panel links, license status, and public readiness.

data_family.description: Optional source-family filter such as 'assessor_tax', 'hazard_context', 'permits', or 'mag_public_projection_and_planning_surfaces'.

license_status.description: Optional license or policy filter such as 'public_source_reviewed', 'public_source_metadata_only', or 'source_specific_review_required'.

panel_id.description: Optional canonical panel filter such as 'panel.acs_nationwide' or 'panel.az_maricopa_mag_multires_enriched'.

public_readiness.description: Optional readiness filter such as 'metadata_public', 'metadata_public_raw_hold', or 'summary_public_rows_missing'.

source_id.description: Optional exact source identifier such as 'census.acs.county_5yr' or 'az.mag_2023_official_mpa_raz_taz_projections'.

source_status.description: Optional status filter such as 'used', 'candidate', 'blocked', or 'mentioned'.

name: list_data_sources

result.description: Raw JSON response body returned by the Homecastr API.

title: List Data Sources
